description_en: Queries the list of available images for personal development environments by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询个人开发环境可用的镜像列表
name: ListServerIdeImages

parameters.help_en: The image name filter condition. Supports fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称过滤条件，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The image label filter condition. Separate multiple Key=Value conditions with commas
parameters.help_zh: 镜像标签过滤条件。多个 Key=Value 条件使用半角逗号分隔
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to continue a query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 用于继续查询的分页令牌，首次调用无需传入
parameters.name: next_token
